value.signature: fn validate_history (acts : & [CandidateAct] , names : & [PublicReference]) -> Result < ValidatedHistory , ValidationError >

review.body: { let bytes = validation_started (acts) ; let result = history_snapshot (acts , names) ; validation_finished (bytes , acts . len () , result . is_ok ()) ; result }
review.item_premise: Checks public history candidates and external names before deriving references. Names cannot inject an act or edge, and dependencies require complete earlier act identities.
